# TinyBVH

Unmodified headers of TinyBVH 1.9.1 by Jacco Bikker and contributors,
revision `c9be3103cc9693b456b0a0353927c11cac7d710f` (see `upstream.json`),
under the MIT license in `LICENSE`.

The path tracer builds its software acceleration structures with it on
devices without ray queries (`src/native/pathtrace/software_bvh.cpp`).
`sources.sha256` lists the vendored files.
